description:
The fz-acn payoff. Interpreted entry dispatch (src/ir_interp/backend.rs:716) and the interpreted guard call edge (:1067) walk the plan graph with two fresh HashSets on every call; native lowering (jobs/native.rs:862, :1870) and executable facts (executable_facts.rs:245) walk it at compile time; keying (jobs/keying.rs:418) walks the matrix arms, dead arms included, plus every guard, per function per root. 19.6% of interpreter samples on tail_recursion.

Change:
- guard_expr_from_ast accrues each guard's leaves (Subject(id) | Pinned(id)) into a producer-held table, threaded exactly like prepared_keys; a nested helper call contributes only its argument expressions.
- compile_dispatch_matrix(matrix, reads) takes the producer's view: pinned_input(PinnedValueId) -> Option<u32>, guard_reads(GuardId) -> &[GuardLeaf]. DispatchGraphBuilder::add_node folds each node into input_demand: Vec<DispatchDemand> sized by the matrix's input_count: a Test node charges its predicate's subject (root ordinal and projection path give the shape), the pin behind Equal(Pinned), a bitstring shape's pinned sizes, its guard's leaves, and both edges' proofs and projections; an Outcome node its evidence; a Fail node nothing. DispatchGraph carries the vector; the plan exposes required_input(i) and input_demand().
- A guard question charges its leaves, never its carrier subject (pattern.rs:529-532 rides every guard on input 0). This removes the spurious whole demand on input 0 for every guarded function (drive_test.rs:16789 pins [Whole, Ignore, Whole] for a wildcard first parameter; it becomes [Ignore, Ignore, Whole]) and the panic at artifact.rs:1096 for a zero-arity guarded clause.
- The out-of-range assertion becomes a construction-time check on the mask's length.
- One telemetry event per compiled plan carries the node counts DispatchCompileStats already computes and drops at pattern.rs:631.
- Readers: backend.rs:716 and :1067 iterate or test the slice; native.rs:862 and :1870 test it; executable_facts.rs reads the plan instead of holding a HashSet; keying.rs:418 reads plan.input_demand() into DemandNode.local.

Deleted: artifact.rs:1079-1212 (method, free function, six collectors); jobs/keying.rs local_dispatch_mask, mark_predicate_inputs, mark_subject_demand, mark_guard_inputs (demand_at_path survives for return_flow_mask); the re-export at compiler2/mod.rs:64; the HashSet results at every reader; ExecutableFacts::entry_dispatch_inputs as a stored set.

Where answers change, all in the graph's favour: arms after a catch-all never become nodes (fixtures 00151, 00152: keying stops marking ordinal 0 from a dead Equal(0); nothing observable moves, the gate proves it); Equal(Pinned) is counted by keying as it already was by artifact.rs.

Tests: dispatch_matrix unit tests build count/2 and a guarded head from source and assert the recorded demand and the uncharged carrier; the lane-form and structural-input tests in backend.rs (4177, 4277) and native.rs (5470) move from HashSet::from([0]) to the slice; drive_test.rs:16719 and :16769 move to the field. tail_recursion joins ARM_ORDER_CENSUS so SOURCE_ORDER_PLANS_ON_THE_CENSUS pins its plan count. Corroborating: tail_recursion interp wall time loses the walk's fifth.

Docs: .agent/docs/semantic-authorities.md "What a dispatch plan demands" is rewritten around the recorded fact; fact-engine.md:706 names the accessor; pattern-matching.md's payload list and dispatch-matrix.md's builder section describe accrual at add_node.
title: The graph records input_demand at add_node; delete both scanners and the interpreter's per-call walk
